title: Chaos Engine
description:
Chaos Engine adds events to the server (UFO, meteorite, glitch events, and others), custom enchantments, and careers.
The plugin also includes a weapon system, cases, a casino, and much more!
body:
**Chaos Engine**

Chaos Engine is a large survival content plugin that makes the server feel alive and unpredictable.
One plugin includes world events, custom enchants, quarries, weapons, shop systems, cases, casino, social commands, and admin tools.

**What the plugin adds**

- Dynamic world events
- Meteorites
- UFO (temporarily not working)
- Glitch events
- Horror Night
- Artifact Hunt

**Custom enchants**

- Drill, Magnet, Auto-Smelt
- Farmer, Lumberjack
- Second Life, Assassin
- Horn, Shell, Boom
- Unbreakable, Pumpkin

**Quarry system**

- 5 quarry levels
- Stable persistence after updates
- Built-in storage and mining logic

**Weapon system**

- Mortar, Shotgun, Assault Rifle
- Rocket Launcher, Railgun, Flamethrower
- Harpoon, Sniper Rifle, SMG
- Unique fire/reload mechanics per weapon type

**Economy and fun**

- Shop with categories
- Weapon cases (IP-limited, configurable)
- Casino

**Social systems**

- Homes: /sethome, /home, /homes, /delhome (/delome)
- Death return: /back
- Random teleport: /rtp
- Teleport requests: /tpa, /tpaccept, /tpdeny
- Trade requests + GUI: /trade, /tradeaccept, /tradedeny
- Clickable accept/deny in chat for TPA and Trade

**Admin features**

- /secret - hidden control menu
- /event - event management
- /chit - anti-cheat check
- Service/admin commands and toggles
  
**Commands**

- /event <ufo|meteor|glitch|horror|artifact> <start|stop|status> [player|all]
- /secret
- /inv
- /shop
- /chase
- /chit <player>
- /casino
- /sethome <name>
- /home <name>
- /delhome <name> (alias: /delome)
- /homes
- /back
- /rtp
- /tpa <player>
- /tpaccept [player]
- /tpdeny [player]
- /trade <player>
- /tradeaccept [player]
- /tradedeny [player]
  
**Permissions**

- faivents.admin - admin access to management functions
- Access to /secret can be restricted in config.yml via secret.require_op
- Compatibility

Minecraft: 1.16+
Cores: Spigot / Paper / Purpur / Pufferfish and compatible forks
Java: 17+
Language: Russian and English
